Can you produce redacted package + manifest + originals SHA256?

alex_oncall: On it. Bind was svc-triage -> infra-operator for ~12min. I'll export CloudTrail JSON and the GitOps PR link (gitops/pr/3120) and include eventIDs.

miriam_sec: KMS activity: GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext at 2024-07-19T21:14:03Z; Decrypt at 21:16:05Z. I'll export CloudTrail for trg-7777 and a CSV summary.

packager-bot: Reminder: Include manifest.csv (filename, sha256, eventID), mapping.md (SOC2/ISO control -> artifact), redaction_script.sh, and HMAC(manifest) using alias/redwood-compliance-hmac.

alex_oncall: Plan: upload redacted package to s3://redwood-compliance/packages/TR-2024-0719-redacted.tar.gz and originals to s3://redwood-compliance/originals/TR-2024-0719/ (gated). ETA today.
